summary: The change adds the requested compiler mapping and public UTF-8 decoder, with focused coverage and passing Go tests. An additional 50,000 raw-byte comparisons matched Node, but the Base64 step does not match Node for some non-ASCII input characters.

findings.claim: Delegating to DecodeXBase64 loses Node compatibility for non-ASCII encoded input. That helper filters UTF-8 bytes, whereas Node interprets the low byte of each UTF-16 code unit during Base64 decoding. For example, U+0151 acts as Q in Node and U+013D acts as padding; the new function ignores both instead, producing different decoded text. Normalize the encoded input with Node-compatible semantics before decoding and cover these cases.
findings.repro: Input: encoded = "Yő==" (U+0151). abap.DecodeBase64(&abap.Session{}, "Yő==") returns "", while Buffer.from("Yő==", "base64").toString() returns "a" on Node 26.9. Also, encoded = "YQĽYg==" (U+013D) returns "a\x06 " in Go versus "a" in Node.
